description: Launch a containerized batch job on AWS ECS (Fargate, EC2, or GPU-backed capacity providers) via Dagster Pipes, streaming CloudWatch logs and Pipes metadata back into the Dagster event log and materializing the result with optional metadata-driven asset checks. Wraps the real dagster_aws.pipes.PipesECSClient -- requires the task's container to open a dagster_pipes.open_dagster_pipes() context.

outputs.description: One asset whose materialization is triggered by the ECS task's PipesContext.report_asset_materialization(), optionally evaluated against configurable metadata_checks.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key emitted by this component.

task_definition.label: Task Definition
task_definition.description: ECS task definition family:revision (or ARN) to run.

container_name.label: Container Name
container_name.description: Name of the container (within the task definition) that opens the Pipes context.

cluster.label: Cluster
cluster.description: ECS cluster name or ARN to run the task in.

subnets.label: Subnets
subnets.description: Subnet IDs for the task's awsvpc network configuration.

aws_region.label: AWS Region
aws_region.description: AWS region for the ecs/logs clients.

security_groups.label: Security Groups
security_groups.description: Security group IDs for the task's awsvpc network configuration.

assign_public_ip.label: Assign Public Ip
assign_public_ip.description: ECS awsvpcConfiguration.assignPublicIp -- 'ENABLED' or 'DISABLED' (the literal strings ECS's API expects, not a boolean).

capacity_provider.label: Capacity Provider
capacity_provider.description: Single capacity provider name (e.g. a GPU capacity provider). Sugar for a one-entry capacityProviderStrategy. Mutually exclusive with capacity_provider_strategy and launch_type.

capacity_provider_strategy.label: Capacity Provider Strategy
capacity_provider_strategy.description: Full ECS capacityProviderStrategy (list of {capacityProvider, weight, base}) for a weighted multi-provider strategy. Mutually exclusive with capacity_provider and launch_type.

launch_type.label: Launch Type
launch_type.description: ECS launchType ('FARGATE' or 'EC2') for accounts not using capacity providers. Mutually exclusive with capacity_provider and capacity_provider_strategy.

container_command.label: Container Command
container_command.description: Command override for the container, e.g. ['python', 'run_batch.py'].

container_environment.label: Container Environment
container_environment.description: Environment variable overrides for the container, as a plain {name: value} dict -- converted internally to ECS's [{name, value}] list shape.

run_task_params_overrides.label: Run Task Params Overrides
run_task_params_overrides.description: Raw overrides deep-merged on top of the run_task_params this component builds, for anything not covered by an explicit field above.

log_group.label: Log Group
log_group.description: CloudWatch log group the task's awslogs driver writes to.

log_stream_prefix.label: Log Stream Prefix
log_stream_prefix.description: CloudWatch log stream prefix, if the task definition's awslogs-stream-prefix isn't the default.

extras.label: Extras
extras.description: Arbitrary extra data passed to PipesECSClient.run(extras=...) and available to the task via the Pipes context.

pipes_container_name.label: Pipes Container Name
pipes_container_name.description: Container name Pipes reads messages from, if different from container_name.

metadata_checks.label: Metadata Checks
metadata_checks.description: Configurable AssetCheckSpec/AssetCheckResult pairs driven by the Pipes result's own metadata, e.g. [{name: schema_valid_rate, metadata_key: schema_valid_rate, comparator: gte, threshold: 0.98, severity: ERROR}]. comparator is one of gte/lte/eq/gt/lt; severity is ERROR (blocking) or WARN. Only evaluated for a single-partition (or unpartitioned) run -- a single_run backfill range folds metadata from multiple task launches into one MaterializeResult and does not emit per-partition checks.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Run the task as a real local subprocess against fake ECS/CloudWatch clients instead of a real ECS cluster. The real PipesECSClient/PipesCloudWatchMessageReader code runs unmodified in both modes -- only the boto3 API calls are faked. Set false for the real cluster.

local_script_path.label: Local Script Path
local_script_path.description: Script demo mode launches locally (via sys.executable) in place of the real ECS task. Required when demo_mode=true.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one Dagster run, launching one ECS task per partition in the range (metadata each task reports is folded into one result keyed '<partition>/<name>'). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default. Ignored when no partitioning is configured.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

name: ECS Pipes Asset
